Henry Schein
is
the world's largest provider of health care products and services to office-based dental and medical practitioners
. A Fortune 500 company founded in 1932, it supplies millions of global customers with over 300,000 branded and corporate-brand products, practice management software, and digital workflow tools.
Henry Schein
Core Offerings & Specialization
Dental Products:
Distributes consumable dental supplies, small tools, large equipment, and specialized orthodontic or laboratory products.
Henry Schein
Medical Supplies:
Provides everyday medical consumables, diagnostic equipment, and safety products to small physician practices and alternate care clinics.

Practice Solutions:
Offers technology solutions, including practice management software
, e-services, equipment repair, and financial services.
